integrity: Full finite-source formulas, constructive interval attainment, analytic proof and a standalone consistency program are provided; numerical tests do not substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only two deterministic stopping dates, a single standard Brownian motion, natural filtration and expected running maximum; the general drawdown-optimality principle is prior art. Independent originality/priority assessment remains open.
title: Sharp two-date Brownian maximum frontier and its symmetric width
